# hitachi_vsp_snapshot (Data Source)

Datasource to show snapshot (Thin Image pair) info in Hitachi VSP storage.

## Example Usage

```terraform
#
# Hitachi VSP Snapshot Data Retrieval
#
# This section defines a data source block to fetch information about specific
# Thin Image snapshots from a Hitachi Virtual Storage Platform (VSP) using
# HashiCorp Configuration Language (HCL).
#
# The data source block "hitachi_vsp_snapshot" retrieves details about snapshots
# associated with the provided parameters. This allows you to access configuration,
# pair status, and relationship properties for the specified snapshots.
#
# Provide the storage system serial number and a valid combination of search patterns.
# Search Patterns (Mutually Exclusive):
#   1. Group Search: [pvol_ldev_id/pvol_ldev_id_hex + snapshot_group_name]
#   2. Pair Search:  [pvol_ldev_id/pvol_ldev_id_hex + mirror_unit_id]
#   3. P-VOL Search: [pvol_ldev_id/pvol_ldev_id_hex only] -> returns all MU numbers
#   4. S-VOL Search: [svol_ldev_id/svol_ldev_id_hex only] -> finds the parent P-VOL
#

#####################
# Example: Group Search
data "hitachi_vsp_snapshot" "snapshot1" {
  serial              = 12345
  snapshot_group_name = "groupname"
  pvol_ldev_id        = 281
  # or
  # pvol_ldev_id_hex = "0X119"
}

output "snapshot1" {
  value = data.hitachi_vsp_snapshot.snapshot1.snapshots
}

output "snapshot1_count" {
  value = data.hitachi_vsp_snapshot.snapshot1.snapshot_count
}

#####################
# Example: Pair Search
data "hitachi_vsp_snapshot" "snapshot2" {
  serial       = 12345
  pvol_ldev_id = 281
  # or
  # pvol_ldev_id_hex = "0X119"
  mirror_unit_id = 3
}

output "snapshot2" {
  value = data.hitachi_vsp_snapshot.snapshot2.snapshots
}

output "snapshot2_count" {
  value = data.hitachi_vsp_snapshot.snapshot2.snapshot_count
}

#####################
# Example: P-VOL Search
data "hitachi_vsp_snapshot" "snapshot3" {
  serial       = 12345
  pvol_ldev_id = 281
  # or
  # pvol_ldev_id_hex = "0X119"
}

output "snapshot3" {
  value = data.hitachi_vsp_snapshot.snapshot3.snapshots
}

output "snapshot3_count" {
  value = data.hitachi_vsp_snapshot.snapshot3.snapshot_count
}

#####################
# Example: S-VOL Search
data "hitachi_vsp_snapshot" "snapshot4" {
  serial       = 12345
  svol_ldev_id = 100
  # or
  # svol_ldev_id_hex = "0X40"
}

output "snapshot4" {
  value = data.hitachi_vsp_snapshot.snapshot4.snapshots
}

output "snapshot4_count" {
  value = data.hitachi_vsp_snapshot.snapshot4.snapshot_count
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `serial` (Number) Serial number of the storage system

### Optional

- `mirror_unit_id` (Number) MU number of the P-VOL.
- `pvol_ldev_id` (Number) P-VOL LDEV ID. Only one of pvol_ldev_id or pvol_ldev_id_hex may be specified, not both.
- `pvol_ldev_id_hex` (String) P-VOL LDEV ID in hexadecimal format. Only one of pvol_ldev_id or pvol_ldev_id_hex may be specified, not both.
- `snapshot_group_name` (String) Name of the snapshot group (1-32 characters).
- `svol_ldev_id` (Number) S-VOL LDEV ID. Only one of svol_ldev_id or svol_ldev_id_hex may be specified, not both.
- `svol_ldev_id_hex` (String) S-VOL LDEV ID in hexadecimal format. Only one of svol_ldev_id or svol_ldev_id_hex may be specified, not both.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `snapshot_count` (Number) Number of snapshots returned.
- `snapshots` (Block List) List of snapshots matching the criteria. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--snapshots))

<a id="nestedblock--snapshots"></a>
### Nested Schema for `snapshots`

Read-Only:

- `can_cascade` (Boolean) True if the pair can be a cascaded pair.
- `concordance_rate` (Number) Concordance rate between P-VOL and S-VOL.
- `is_clone` (Boolean) True if the pair has the clone attribute.
- `is_consistency_group` (Boolean) True if pair is created in CTG mode.
- `is_redirect_on_write` (Boolean) True if the pair is Thin Image Advanced.
- `is_virtual_clone_parent_volume` (Boolean) True if the volume has the vClone Parent attribute. For VSP One B20/B85 only.
- `is_virtual_clone_volume` (Boolean) True if the volume has the vClone attribute or vClone Parent attribute. For VSP One B20/B85 only
- `is_written_in_svol` (Boolean) True if data was written to the S-VOL when status was PSUS/PFUS.
- `mirror_unit_id` (Number) MU number of the P-VOL.
- `primary_or_secondary` (String) Attribute of the LDEV (P-VOL or S-VOL).
- `progress_rate` (Number) Progress of processing (%).
- `pvol_ldev_id` (Number) LDEV number of the Primary Volume (P-VOL).
- `pvol_ldev_id_hex` (String) P-VOL LDEV ID in hexadecimal format
- `pvol_processing_status` (String) Processing status of the P-VOL pair (E: In Progress, N: Not In Progress).
- `retention_period_hours` (Number) The remaining period for which snapshot data of the Thin Image Advanced pair is retained (in hours) if set.
- `snapshot_data_read_only` (Boolean) True if the snapshot data has the read-only attribute.
- `snapshot_group_name` (String) Name of the snapshot group.
- `snapshot_id` (String) Identifier in the format 'pvolLdevId,muNumber'.
- `snapshot_pool_id` (Number) ID of the pool where snapshot data is created.
- `split_time` (String) Timestamp when snapshot data was created.
- `status` (String) Current pair status.
- `svol_ldev_id` (Number) LDEV number of the Secondary Volume (S-VOL).
- `svol_ldev_id_hex` (String) S-VOL LDEV ID in hexadecimal format
- `svol_processing_status` (String) Processing status of the S-VOL pair (E: In Progress, N: Not In Progress).
